desc: convert Serbian text from Cyrillic to Latin script
doc: recode-sr-latin - convert Serbian text from Cyrillic to Latin script

Recode Serbian text from Cyrillic to Latin script. The input text is read from standard input. The converted text is output to standard output.

Informative output:

-h, --help
display this help and exit
-V, --version
output version information and exit
